Cell.description: Core identity of the cell spec (manufacturer, model, format, chemistry).

chemistry.description: Overall cell chemistry label (e.g. 'Li-ion', 'NiMH'). Use the recognised labels where they apply (see the property keys reference); other values are carried as literals.

datasheet_revision.description: Revision label of the source datasheet.

id.description: Canonical IRI of the cell spec.

Measurement.description: A measured quantity attached to the item, complementing declared datasheet properties.

name.description: Name of the measured property (snake_case key).

property.description: Ontology label or IRI of the measured property, when known.

source.description: Where the measurement came from (instrument, dataset, or report).

Provenance.description: Where the information in this record came from: source type, file or URL, citation, and retrieval time.

battinfo_version.description: Version of the battinfo library that wrote this record (semantic versioning); stamped on save.

citation.description: Resolvable citation target to use for attribution, typically a DOI URL.

citation_doi.description: DOI of the source publication (bare '10.xxxx/...' form). Prefer provenance.citation with a DOI resolver URL.

extracted_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the information was extracted from the source.

source_file.description: Path of the source document the record was extracted from.

source_id.description: Identifier of this record's source in the originating system.

source_type.description: Whether the record was hand-curated or extracted from a datasheet.

source_url.description: URL of the source document or landing page, when available.

Quality.description: Extraction quality report listing missing or inferred fields and warnings.

inferred_fields.description: Property keys filled by inference rather than read directly from the source.

missing_fields.description: Property keys expected but not found in the source.

RangeSpec.description: Minimum/maximum pair of SpecItems for range-valued properties.

RawExtraction.description: Verbatim extraction context recording where in the source a value came from.

page.description: 1-based page number in the source document.

text.description: Verbatim source text the value was extracted from.

SpecItem.description: A single quantitative property: point value or range plus a unit, with optional verbatim extraction context, a co_type stating the nature of the value (Nominal, Measured, Rated, Conventional), and the conditions under which it holds.

co_type.description: Nature of the value. Nominal: the design or target value as specified (default for spec records). Measured: obtained by measurement on a physical item (default for instance records). Rated: a guaranteed value established under a stated rating procedure (datasheet 'rated capacity'). Conventional: fixed by convention or calculation (e.g. theoretical capacity). Drives the EMMO property-nature co-type in JSON-LD; until the EMMO RatedProperty class is published, Rated is exported as ConventionalProperty.

conditions.description: Measurement parameters or conditions under which this quantity holds, as a map of condition name to quantity (e.g. discharge_c_rate, lower_voltage_limit, upper_voltage_limit, temperature, counter_electrode, cycle_number). Emitted as hasMeasurementParameter in JSON-LD.

max_value.description: Upper bound when the source specifies a range.

min_value.description: Lower bound when the source specifies a range.

raw.description: Verbatim extraction context (source text, page, confidence) this value was parsed from.

sample_count.description: How many members the value (and standard_deviation) were computed over — e.g. 8 cells. Without it a spread cannot be read.

standard_deviation.description: Dispersion of the sample the value summarises, in the same unit as value. A sample standard deviation over sample_count members, not a measurement uncertainty. Zero is meaningful: it says every member carried the same number.

typical_value.description: Typical value when the source distinguishes typical from nominal or limit values.

unit.description: Canonical compact unit symbol/code, for example V, A, Ah, Wh/kg.

unit_code.description: Machine-readable unit code (schema.org unitCode convention, e.g. UN/CEFACT).

unit_text.description: Human-readable unit text as written in the source (schema.org unitText).

value.description: Point numeric value. A value that is not purely numeric belongs in value_text, never as a string here.

value_text.description: Verbatim value text when the source value cannot be parsed to a number.

SpecSet.description: Named quantity map of datasheet-style cell properties; every allowed key holds a SpecItem quantity. Under cell-spec `properties`, read each key as the declared value for the cell model. Under cell-instance `measured`, read each key as the value measured for this cell (e.g. nominal_capacity = measured discharge capacity).

ac_internal_resistance.description: AC internal resistance, typically at 1 kHz.

calendar_life.description: Calendar life: storage time to the end-of-life threshold.

capacity_fade.description: Capacity fade over the stated test.

capacity_threshold_exhaustion.description: Capacity threshold defining end of life (e.g. 80% of nominal).

charging_temperature_max.description: Alias of maximum_charging_temperature used by some sources.

charging_temperature_min.description: Alias of minimum_charging_temperature used by some sources.

cycle_life.description: Number of full cycles to the end-of-life capacity threshold.

cycle_life_c_rate.description: C-rate at which the cycle-life figure was established.

diameter.description: Cell diameter (cylindrical and coin formats). Not allowed for prismatic or pouch formats.

discharging_temperature_max.description: Alias of maximum_discharging_temperature used by some sources.

discharging_temperature_min.description: Alias of minimum_discharging_temperature used by some sources.

energy_density.description: Volumetric energy density (energy per unit volume).

height.description: Cell height: the terminal-to-base dimension along the cell axis. For coin cells this is the total thickness per IEC 60086. Allowed for all formats.

internal_resistance.description: Internal resistance, by the method the source states.

length.description: Cell length: the larger of the two in-plane dimensions of a prismatic or pouch cell (length >= width). Not allowed for cylindrical or coin formats.

min_capacity.description: Alias of minimum_capacity used by some sources.

nominal_capacity.description: Nominal capacity declared by the manufacturer.

power_capability.description: Power capability under the stated conditions.

power_density.description: Volumetric power density (power per unit volume).

power_energy_ratio.description: Ratio of maximum power to energy (P/E ratio).

rated_capacity.description: Rated capacity established under the manufacturer's rating procedure.

rated_energy.description: Rated energy established under the rating procedure.

round_trip_energy_efficiency_50pct.description: Round-trip energy efficiency at 50% of expected cycle life (EU Battery Regulation).

specific_energy.description: Gravimetric energy density (energy per unit mass).

specific_power.description: Gravimetric power density (power per unit mass).

state_of_health.description: State of health relative to nominal capacity.

storage_temperature_max.description: Alias of maximum_storage_temperature used by some sources.

storage_temperature_min.description: Alias of minimum_storage_temperature used by some sources.

thickness.description: Cell thickness: the smallest dimension of a prismatic or pouch cell. Not allowed for cylindrical or coin formats.

typical_energy.description: Typical energy delivered under the datasheet reference conditions.

width.description: Cell width: the smaller of the two in-plane dimensions of a prismatic or pouch cell (length >= width). Not allowed for cylindrical or coin formats.

description: Harmonized cell record shape shared by cell specs and cell instances: identity, a named map of quantitative properties (SpecSet), measurements, and provenance.

cell.description: Core identity of the cell spec (manufacturer, model, format, chemistry).

measurements.description: Measured quantities complementing the datasheet values.

notes.description: Free-text notes carried with the record.

properties.description: Extracted datasheet properties of the cell.

provenance.description: Where the extracted cell information came from.

schema_version.description: Version of the record schema this document conforms to (semantic versioning); stamped by the library on save.
